title.zh: 为支付W·E·普利亚姆担任菲律宾群岛海关特别副税务官自1903年9月11日至10月19日期间的薪金1007比索65仙（菲律宾货币），以及其于1903年9月11日至10月19日期间自旧金山赴马尼拉途中所发生的差旅费而拨款的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE THOUSAND AND SEVEN PESOS AND SIXTY-FIVE CENTAVOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, TO PAY THE SALARY OF W. E. PULLIAM, SPECIAL DEPUTY COLLECTOR OF CUSTOMS FOR THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, FROM SEPTEMBER ELEVENTH TO OCTOBER NINETEENTH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE, AND TRAVELING EXPENSES INCURRED BY HIM WHILE EN ROUTE FROM SAN FRANCISCO TO MANILA BETWEEN SEPTEMBER ELEVENTH AND OCTOBER NINETEENTH.

title.vi: Đạo luật cấp kinh phí 1.007 peso và 65 xu tiền Philippines để trả lương cho W. E. Pulliam, Phó Giám đốc Hải quan Đặc biệt cho Quần đảo Philippines, từ ngày 11 tháng 9 đến ngày 19 tháng 10 năm 1903, và chi phí đi lại của ông trong hành trình từ San Francisco đến Manila từ ngày 11 tháng 9 đến ngày 19 tháng 10
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวนหนึ่งพันเจ็ดเปโซและหกสิบห้าเซนตาวอสสกุลฟิลิปปินส์เพื่อจ่ายเงินเดือนของดับเบิลยู.อี.พูลเลียม ผู้เก็บภาษีศุลกากรพิเศษสำหรับหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ ตั้งแต่วันที่ ๑๑ กันยายน ถึงวันที่ ๑๙ ตุลาคม พ.ศ. ๒๔๔๖ และค่าใช้จ่ายในการเดินทางของเขาขณะเดินทางจากซานฟรานซิสโกไปยังมะนิลาในช่วงเวลาดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan jumlah sebesar seribu tujuh peso dan enam puluh lima sentavo mata uang Filipina untuk membayar gaji W. E. Pulliam, Deputi Kepala Bea Cukai Khusus untuk Kepulauan Filipina, dari 11 September hingga 19 Oktober 1903, serta biaya perjalanan yang dikeluarkannya dalam perjalanan dari San Francisco ke Manila antara tanggal 11 dan 19 Oktober
title.ms: Akta mengeluarkan peruntukan sebanyak seribu tujuh peso dan enam puluh lima sentavo mata wang Filipina untuk membayar gaji W. E. Pulliam, Timbalan Pengarah Kastam Khas bagi Kepulauan Filipina, dari 11 September hingga 19 Oktober 1903, dan perbelanjaan perjalanan yang ditanggungnya semasa perjalanan dari San Francisco ke Manila antara 11 dan 19 Oktober

text.en:
The following sums, in Philippine currency, are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated:
For the payment of salary of W. E. Pulliam, Special Deputy Collector of Customs for the Philippine Islands,
from September eleventh to October nineteenth, nineteen hundred and three, inclusive, at four thousand
dollars, United States currency, per annum, eight hundred and sixty-six pesos and sixty-seven centavos,
Philippine currency.
For reimbursement to W. E. Pulliam of traveling expenses in Traveling expenses, curred while en route from
San Francisco to Manila, between September eleventh and October nineteenth, nineteen hundred and three,
one hundred and forty pesos and ninety-eight centavos, Philippine currency.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 3, 1903.
